answer: Each identity locks a 45-credit bond and builds a glacier archive of its work. Unpredictably, a zephyr check asks a question from that archive, and the identity must answer live within ten minutes, matching its history. Auditors replay the check; a mismatch or missed check freezes the bond 10 epochs. 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 in bonds plus 30 per identity per epoch for a responder, since one responder cannot pass two checks at once. A rented-responder farm fails when transcripts cluster and bonds burn. An honest agent pays one bond and earns its nectar reward for its checks.
